Exact helper: `imported_session_id` in `crates/cw-harnesses/src/adapters/generic.rs`.

```rust
fn imported_session_id(harness: HarnessKind, id: &str) -> String {
    let id = if harness == HarnessKind::Omp {
        id
    } else {
        id.char_indices()
            .nth(12)
            .map(|(byte_offset, _)| &id[..byte_offset])
            .unwrap_or(id)
    };
    format!("{}_{}", harness.as_str(), id)
}
```

Behavior:

- **OMP / `HarnessKind::Omp`**
  - Session ID is used unchanged.
  - Final stored ID is `omp_<id>`.
  - Citation: `crates/cw-harnesses/src/adapters/generic.rs`, `imported_session_id`, `if harness == HarnessKind::Omp { id }`.

- **Non-OMP harnesses**
  - Session ID is truncated to the first 12 characters when possible.
  - `char_indices().nth(12)` finds the byte offset of the 13th character; slicing `&id[..byte_offset]` keeps the first 12 characters.
  - If the ID has fewer than 13 characters, it is left unchanged.
  - Final stored ID is `<harness>_<first-12-chars-or-full-id>`.
  - Citation: `crates/cw-harnesses/src/adapters/generic.rs`, `imported_session_id`, `id.char_indices().nth(12).map(|(byte_offset, _)| &id[..byte_offset]).unwrap_or(id)`.
